description.p: Cullfinch opens a directory of photos, shows one thumbnail per photo even when a JPG and one or more RAW files belong together, and runs comparison flows over a selection. The versus tree shows two candidates at a time until one remains; the image wall shows everything at once and removes what you click.
Eliminating a photo only marks it. Files are never touched until you review the exact list and choose to move it to Trash, and every RAW file always travels with its JPG.
